evals.name: top-bottlenecks-default-target
evals.prompt: Do a ruthless efficiency audit of the Django app at /home/bguest/personal-skills/skills/_fixtures/vuln-app. Find the worst performance/cost problems and quantify each. Do not change your working directory.

assertions.text: Reports between 1 and 3 confirmed findings (respects the stop-early cap)
Surfaces at least one N+1 query pattern (get_order_totals E1 or enrich_orders E2)
Every finding includes a concrete cost analysis (complexity class or query count as a function of N), not just 'this is slow'
Every finding cites a file:line location
All reported findings are efficiency/performance issues, not security vulnerabilities
Does not report the warm_rate_cache decoy (D2), whose cost is fixed at 3 and does not scale

evals.name: cost-scale-trap
evals.prompt: Something in /home/bguest/personal-skills/skills/_fixtures/vuln-app is going to fall over as we grow. Find the paths whose cost actually scales with our data or traffic — I don't care about micro-optimizations or things that are bounded, just the ones that blow up as the numbers get big. Stay in the current directory.

assertions.text: Reports between 1 and 3 confirmed findings (respects the stop-early cap)
Findings are genuinely scaling hot paths (N+1 E1/E2, unbounded load E4, or per-item HTTP E5)
Does NOT report the warm_rate_cache loop (D2) — recognizes its cost is bounded at 3 and cannot scale
Each finding quantifies how cost grows with N (queries, memory, or HTTP calls as a function of data/traffic)

evals.name: with-sentry-signal
evals.prompt: Efficiency-audit /home/bguest/personal-skills/skills/_fixtures/vuln-app. Our Sentry shows the /events/export and /invoices/lines transactions dominating total time (see https://ghgsat.sentry.io/performance/). Find the top offenders behind that. Don't cd anywhere.

assertions.text: Findings concentrate on the events-export / invoice-render hot paths flagged by Sentry (export_all_events E4 or the uncached FX call E5)
Acknowledges the Sentry signal (uses it to prioritize, or notes it could not fetch it) rather than ignoring it
Every finding includes a concrete cost analysis and a fix
